title: DEV: Fix order-dependent mention lookup in notifications controller spec
body:
The spec added in #43983 looks up the new mention with an unordered `find_by!`, but the outer `fab!(:notification)` is also a `mentioned` notification for the same user. On a seq scan the setup row wins and `display_name` is `nil`. Scoping the lookup to the new post's topic makes it deterministic.

Related to https://patch.discourse.org/patch-triage/2662
